- Evidence bundle: SOC 2 attestation letter (signed PDF), evidence matrix (controls mapping), one sample month of anonymized logs + ingestion manifest. Target delivery: 2025-06-10.
- Retention change: can increase log retention from 90 -> 180 days for your account. There is a storage/ingestion cost delta — see pricing delta below. We can stage the retention change on a start date you pick; migration is non-disruptive.
- Capacity uplift: we can reserve a 30% burst buffer and bump seat licensing by 25% effective on renewal. We will provide a firm quote for seat-rate and burst fee.

Proposed timeline (mutual action plan):
1) Confirm acceptance of retention change and seat uplift by 2025-05-22.
2) Redwood prepares evidence bundle and draft SOC 2 addendum (internal review) by 2025-05-30.
3) Customer review window + final signoff by 2025-06-12.
4) Evidence delivery and retention cutover by 2025-06-15.
5) Renewal effective date: 2025-07-15.

Preliminary pricing delta (draft):
- 90 -> 180 days log retention: +$0.018 per GB/month (estimated +$1,200/mo for Acme current usage)
- Seat uplift (25%): prorated for remainder of term; new seat price $X per seat (we will attach exact numbers in the MAP).
- 30% burst capacity reserved pool: $Y/month (firm quote attached).

Attachments I'm including: mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx (MAP), ACME_SOC2_EVIDENCE_MATRIX_v1.xlsx, log_retention_proposal.pdf (cost model).
